eval_dimensions.name: Decision Gate Enforcement
eval_dimensions.description: Blocking choices call AskUserQuestion instead of substituting plain-text questions

eval_dimensions.name: Approval and Draft Prechecks
eval_dimensions.description: Already-approved and draft PRs stop before any Google Chat post

eval_dimensions.name: Per-Repo Config Resolution
eval_dimensions.description: Prepare subcommand owns YAML reads, skip/ask routing, and message formatting

eval_dimensions.name: Transport Delegation
eval_dimensions.description: Sending goes through Skill(Dev10x:gchat), never a direct gchat-send CLI call

evals.name: Unconfigured repo opens the space/mentions gate
evals.description: Step 2 with ask=true must block on AskUserQuestion for the space alias rather than guessing a space
evals.input: /Dev10x:gchat-review-request for a PR in a repo absent from gchat-config-code-review-requests.yaml

assertions.signal: gate1_uses_tool — AskUserQuestion called to collect the space alias when prepare returns ask=true
gate1_no_plain_text — no inline 'Which space should I post to?' prose asked before the tool call
Prepare JSON envelope reports ask=true for the unconfigured repo

evals.name: Formatted message is confirmed before it is posted
evals.description: Step 3 must present the rendered message and block on AskUserQuestion before any send
evals.input: /Dev10x:gchat-review-request for a PR in a configured repo

assertions.signal: gate2_uses_tool — AskUserQuestion called at the Step 3 confirmation point
gate2_correct_options — options are exactly 'Post to Google Chat' and 'Skip'
no_auto_post — no message is sent before the user answers the confirmation gate

evals.name: Sending delegates to Dev10x:gchat
evals.description: Step 4 must invoke the transport skill so transport rules stay centralized
evals.input: /Dev10x:gchat-review-request with the confirmation gate answered 'Post to Google Chat'

assertions.signal: skill1_uses_tool — Skill(Dev10x:gchat) is invoked as a tool call
no_direct_cli_send — 'dev10x skill notify gchat-send' is never run directly from this skill

evals.name: Approved or draft PRs stop before the gates
evals.description: Step 0 and Step 0.5 short-circuit without opening a gate or posting
evals.input: /Dev10x:gchat-review-request for a PR that is a draft, and for one already human-approved on its current HEAD

assertions.signal: no_post_when_approved — a human APPROVED review matching headRefOid stops the flow; bot approvals do not count
no_post_when_draft — a draft PR is reported as needing mark-ready and nothing is posted
force_bypasses_prechecks — --force skips both prechecks but still honors the Step 3 confirmation gate

evals.name: Repo configured with skip:true posts nothing
evals.description: A skip=true envelope reports the skip and ends without opening any gate
evals.input: /Dev10x:gchat-review-request for a repo with skip: true in gchat-config-code-review-requests.yaml

assertions.signal: Prepare JSON envelope reports skip=true with a reason naming the repo
no_send_on_skip — Skill(Dev10x:gchat) is not invoked for a skip-configured repo

should_trigger: A PR needs a Google Chat review notification posted to the team space
Direct invocation as /Dev10x:gchat-review-request with a PR number and repo
should_not_trigger: The review request should go to Slack (use Dev10x:slack-review-request)
An arbitrary non-review message needs sending to a space (use Dev10x:gchat)
Google Chat has no configured space or service-account key yet (run Dev10x:gchat first-time setup)
